name: med_mllm_safety_benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate the safety behavior of medical multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) on medical queries and scenarios, measuring propensity to produce harmful, incorrect, or unsafe medical advice. It contains safety-oriented prompts/examples (potentially image+text) and is intended to assess refusal, hallucination, privacy leakage, and other safety failure modes.
evaluation_method: accuracy / classification of safe vs unsafe (often measured via human annotation or automated safety classifiers)
reputation: Niche/specialized dataset with limited but growing use within medical-safety evaluation of multimodal LLMs.
